title: Cheap cheap cheap
text:
Cheap cheap cheap. I have to say, this isn't the nicest set. The slice lifter is ok, and the strongest piece of the three.

The pizza cutter is wobbly and not very strong. It feels like it is going to break with each cut.

The silicone brush is totally useless. It is super thin, doesn't have many bristles and is also pretty useless.

Overall, save your money and avoid this set. I cannot think of even one reason to get it.
